welcome.title: Welcome to your Traflinq trial
welcome.bodyPool: You have 72 hours to explore pool car management and chauffeur bookings.
welcome.bodyShuttle: You have 72 hours to explore shuttle routes and employee commute.
welcome.bodyBoth: You have 72 hours to explore pool chauffeur and shuttle commute. We'll guide you through both modules.

sectionPool.title: Part 1 — Pool (chauffeur)
sectionPool.body: Start with pool fleet and bookings.

sectionShuttle.title: Part 2 — Shuttle
sectionShuttle.body: Now set up shuttle fleet, routes, and employee assignments.

poolWelcome.title: Pool trial — chauffeur bookings
poolWelcome.body: Add a vehicle and chauffeur driver to your fleet, then assign them when you create a booking.

poolVehicle.title: Add a fleet vehicle
poolVehicle.body: Register a company vehicle in Fleet. Assign it when creating a self-managed chauffeur booking.

poolDriver.title: Invite a chauffeur driver
poolDriver.body: Add a chauffeur-type driver to your fleet for bookings.

poolBooking.title: Create a booking
poolBooking.body: Create a self-managed chauffeur booking using your pool vehicle and driver. Add employees first if you need passengers other than yourself.

shuttleWelcome.title: Shuttle trial — routes & employees
shuttleWelcome.body: Use your company fleet: add a vehicle and shuttle driver, then assign them when you create a route.

shuttleVehicle.title: Add a fleet vehicle
shuttleVehicle.body: Register a company vehicle with seat capacity. You will assign it to a shuttle route later.

shuttleDriver.title: Invite a shuttle driver
shuttleDriver.body: Add a shuttle-type driver to your fleet. They use these credentials in the driver mobile app.

shuttleRoute.title: Create a route
shuttleRoute.body: Build a route with at least two stops and assign your shuttle vehicle and driver.

shuttleEmployees.title: Add & assign employees
shuttleEmployees.body: Create up to 3 employees (6 if you selected both modules), then assign them to your route from the Routes page.

shuttleTest.title: Generate trips & test
shuttleTest.body: Open your route to track trips. Generate scheduled trips for today, then test with the driver and employee apps.

app.title: Mobile apps
app.body: Drivers use the chauffeur/shuttle driver app with credentials from the invite step. Employees use the employee app with credentials shown when you create each employee.
